tx.reason_hint: min. 3 characters, kept in the audit log
tx.confirm_cancel: Cancels this pending request and releases any held funds. The rider is not charged.
tx.confirm_approve: Verifies the payment and moves the money. Enter the bank / CCP reference you checked.
tx.confirm_reject: Rejects the request and releases any held funds. The reason is recorded.
tx.confirm_reverse: Posts the opposite entry to the wallet and marks this transaction reversed. Agent dues follow automatically.
tx.entries_empty: No wallet entries linked to this transaction.
tx.online_payment_desc: The card payment behind this deposit, as the payment provider reports it.
tx.online_none: No card payment was started for this deposit.

wallet.frozen_note: This wallet is frozen — withdrawals are refused (credits still land). Reason: {reason} · {when}
wallet.adjust_desc: Posts a credit or debit entry to the wallet. The server enforces your adjustment limit.
wallet.freeze_desc: Blocks withdrawals from this wallet. The rider is notified.
wallet.unfreeze_desc: Lets this wallet withdraw again. The rider is notified.
wallet.statement_desc: Every ledger entry with the running balance, newest first
wallet.not_backfilled: This wallet has not been backfilled yet — the rider's live balance still comes from the legacy calculation.

review.electronic_desc: Deposits and withdrawals waiting for a staff check
review.payments_desc: Payments made in the app by agents and merchants — confirm once the money has arrived
review.online_desc: Card payments that need a look. Re-check asks the provider again: a lapsed checkout is closed (or credited if it was paid after all); an amount mismatch is only credited once the provider reports the right amount.
review.online_empty: No online payment needs a look.

pay.record_desc: Record cash received from {name}. It counts against their dues straight away.
pay.confirm_desc: Confirms the money has arrived. It will count against the dues and the payer is notified.
pay.reject_desc: Rejects this payment; it will not count against the dues. The payer is notified with your reason.

offers.desc: Deposit bonuses riders can pick when adding money.
offers.err_title: Add the title in English, French and Arabic.
offers.err_bonus: Enter a bonus above 0 (percent: up to 100).
offers.err_window: Set a start and an end, with the end after the start.
offers.err_limit: Enter a whole number, 1 or more.

settings.fees_desc: Charged to the rider on agent deposits and withdrawals
settings.limits_desc: Per transaction, per day and per month (Algiers calendar)
settings.operations_desc: Expiry, agent cash and adjustment limits
settings.require_pin_desc: Turn on after the app update that asks for the PIN is out.
settings.dues_methods_desc: Shown to agents and merchants when they pay their dues
settings.electronic_desc: Blink's receiving accounts riders pay into
settings.electronic_enabled_desc: When off, the app hides the electronic option.
settings.err_max_lt_min: The maximum must be at least the minimum.
settings.err_month_lt_day: The monthly limit can't be below the daily one.
settings.err_quick: Enter positive whole numbers, separated by commas.
settings.err_accounts: Every account needs a label, number and holder (and at least one when electronic is on).
settings.err_methods: Each method needs a unique id (lowercase letters, digits, - or _, up to 32) and a label.
settings.fees_in_pricing: Deposit and withdrawal fees come from Pricing & Fees (Blink Cash fee rate, per wilaya): the rate riders are quoted and charged.

recon.title: Reconciliation
recon.backfill_desc: Posts opening balances for riders who aren't on the ledger yet and switches their wallet to it. Safe to re-run.
recon.mismatches_desc: Ledger balance vs the legacy derived balance, differences above 0.01 DA

err.insufficient_funds: Insufficient funds — the wallet's available balance can't cover this.
err.not_pending: This request is no longer pending.
err.not_completed: Only completed transactions can be reversed.
err.wrong_agent: This request belongs to another agent.
err.not_found: Not found — it may have been removed.
err.adjust_limit: That's above your adjustment limit. Ask a super admin.
err.negative_balance: That would take the wallet below zero.
err.agent_limit_reached: The agent has reached their cash limit.
err.invalid: Check the fields — something isn't valid.
err.forbidden: Your staff role isn't allowed to do this.

errors.network: Couldn't reach Blink Server. Try again.
errors.session: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: Your staff role isn't allowed to do this.
errors.not_found: Not found — it was removed, or the Blink Cash server update isn't deployed yet.
errors.conflict: This changed in the meantime. Reload and try again. ({detail})
errors.throttled: Too many requests — wait a moment.

reason.provider_error: The provider couldn't open the checkout
reason.async_payment_failed: The bank declined it after checkout

gw.providers_desc: Card payment providers. Their keys are set on the server; a provider is on only when its keys are there.
